__broaden__.αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg.: ’himself’, reinforcing a personal pronoun (σοὶ δ’ αὐτῷ ’to you yourself’) · also used alone as a plain personal pronoun, ’him’, not reinforcing anything (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ μηχανόωνται ’are plotting against him’) · also with a noun, ’own, very’, in the dat. of accompaniment: αὐτῷ φάρει ’with the cloak itself, cloak and all’ · also reinforcing a 1st-person pronoun: ’myself’ (ἐμοὶ αὐτῷ) · also plain pronoun of a thing, ’it’, after a preposition (ἀμφ’ αὐτῷ ’around it’)
__broaden__.μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’) · also standing for a noun left out: ’a black (ewe)’ (θῆλύν τε μέλαιναν)
__broaden__.μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’)
__broaden__.οἴῳ: οἶος — alone, only; adj., masc. dat. sg., agreeing with an implied dat. of the speaker: ’alone’ · also agreeing with a named dative: ’to Tiresias alone’ (Τειρεσίῃ … οἴῳ), ’he alone’ (τῷ … οἴῳ)
__broaden__.τρίτον: τρίτος — third; ordinal numeral, neut. nom. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: τρίτον ἄνδρα ’a third man’ (as direct object) · also neut. acc. sg., direct object: τρίτον ἦμαρ ’the third day’ (τέλεσ’ Ἠώς ’Dawn completed the third day’) · also with the article, neut. acc. sg. adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time, thirdly’
__broaden__.τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. (τὸ πάροιθεν ’that which was before’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’that, the’ (τὸ σῆμα ’that mark’) · also article-like before the adverb πάρος: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also article-like before an ordinal, adverbial: τὸ τρίτον ’the third time’
__broaden__.τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: which; neut. nom. pl. (μῆλα, τὰ … κατάκειτ’ ’the flocks, which lie’)
__broaden__.φέρῃσιν: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. subj. 3 sg., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φέρῃ), in a purpose clause: ’so that it may carry’ · also with κε in a main clause, a vivid future: ’will carry’ (τὴν δέ κέ τοι πνοιὴ … φέρῃσιν)
__broaden__.ἐπιβὰς: ἐπιβαίνω — step upon, set foot on, alight; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.; usually + gen., but here + acc. (Πιερίην), an epic extension meaning ’reach, arrive at’: ’having stepped upon, alighting’ · also + gen., the usual construction (Κίρκης ἐπιβὰς … εὐνῆς ’mounting Circe’s bed’)
__broaden__.ὤτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur, exhort; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they urged on’ · also impf. 1 sg.: ’I urged on’
